maddeler.e:
اقتصدا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَدَا (iqtaṣadā) /iq.ta.sˤa.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اُقْتُصِدَا (uqtuṣidā) /uq.tu.sˤi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اِقْتَصِدَا (iqtaṣidā) /iq.ta.sˤi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
